verdict.rationale: Pipedream's own docs list a built-in "Schedule" trigger for workflows, and a community thread cites a 30s execution limit "for cron", so recurring scheduled workflows exist. However, the evidence is only a one-word item in the trigger list, with no documentation of cron syntax, intervals, time zones or schedule management. missing for 10: documented recurring schedule configuration (cron expressions or intervals, time zones), programmatic or CLI or API creation of schedules, and hands-on corroboration of scheduled runs beyond a single community mention of cron limits.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Today, we support the following triggers: ... HTTP / Webhook ... Schedule ... Email ... RSS
